query: "obstructive sleep apnea"[Title] AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND 2019:2026[pdat]
note: Chinese Thoracic Society 2025. Richest abstract found to date (rec=23). PSG gold standard, high-risk screening, CPAP default modality. Filled a missing diagnosis: section.

query: "celiac disease"[Title] OR "coeliac disease"[Title] AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND 2019:2026[pdat]
note: ESsCD 2025 Part 1 Diagnostic Approach. HLA-DQ2/DQ8 typing. Filled a missing diagnosis: section. Abstract states no NPV rationale - that claim belongs in notes, not evidence.

query: "peripheral artery disease"[Title] AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND 2019:2026[pdat]
note: ESVS focused update. Supervised exercise + best medical therapy first-line; endovascular revascularisation restricted to persistent lifestyle-limiting symptoms. Non-drug first-line recommendation - would have scored zero under the old drug-only scorer.

query: "cervical cancer"[Title] AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND (screening[Title] OR HPV[Title]) AND 2020:2026[pdat]
note: Korean Society of Gynecologic Oncology. HPV 16/18 genotyping. Diagnostic recommendation naming no drug - the worked example that motivated the modality-agnostic rescore.

query: "dental caries"[Title] OR caries[Title] AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND 2019:2026[pdat]
note: German S3. Risk-adapted fluoride preparations. Full-text PDF source: pick bracket-free snippets, citation markers like [34] break the reference validator.

query: ("pulmonary hypertension"[Title] OR "pulmonary arterial hypertension"[Title]) AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND 2019:2026[pdat]  [+ a second pass widened to ESC/ERS and "guidelines for the diagnosis"[Title]]
note: recommendation_sentences=0 across 12 candidates over two search passes (best: 42292971, 41493051 - both intervention terms only, no recommendation cue). Scored with the modality-agnostic vocabulary, so this is not a drug-lens artifact: the abstracts state no specific recommendation of any modality, including the diagnostic ones expected here (right heart catheterization, echocardiography). Needs full text. NEC caution: acute pulmonary embolism guidelines surface under PH queries and are a different entity.

query: (amyloidosis[Title] OR "cardiac amyloidosis"[Title] OR ATTR[Title]) AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND 2019:2026[pdat]
note: Best hit 41277424 scores rec=1 but the sentence is meta - 'Four conditional recommendations and 3 good practice statements were established to provide guidance for proper testing and workup' - a COUNT of recommendations, not a recommendation. A known scorer limitation: recommendation cues match sentences that describe recommendations existing. Not used.

query: ("systemic sclerosis"[Title] OR scleroderma[Title]) AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND 2019:2026[pdat]
note: Portuguese recommendations for Raynaud's/digital ulcers in SSc. Nifedipine first-line. NOTE: the top-scoring hit (39874231, rec=1) was a META sentence ('These updated recommendations include...'); the lower-scored 38956991 carried the actual recommendation. Score is triage, not verdict.

query: "eosinophilic esophagitis"[Title] AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND 2019:2026[pdat]
note: ACG Clinical Guideline. Clinical/endoscopic/histologic monitoring of treatment response. Filled a missing diagnosis: section (MAXO:0001193 esophagogastroduodenoscopy). The abstract states no diagnostic eosinophil threshold - only affiliations matched an eosinophil/biopsy grep.

query: bronchiectasis[Title] AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND 2019:2026[pdat]
note: PRIMARY ERS clinical practice guideline (Eur Respir J). Strong recommendation for airway clearance techniques - a non-drug recommendation. See the primary-vs-secondary caveat below: 41629091 (a Chinese-language interpretation OF this guideline) was cited first and corrected on review.

note: S3 Guideline Urticaria Part 2. Non-sedating second-generation H1 antihistamines first-line. The entry had NO treatments section at all; this created it.

query: "chronic pancreatitis"[Title] AND "Practice Guideline"[Publication Type] AND 2019:2026[pdat]
note: Highest score in the batch-16 sweep (rec=14) yet unusable. Top hit 36008176's leading sentence is META ('This review is framed around the 8 best practice advice points agreed upon by the authors'). Runner-up 35945698 recommends Ringer's lactate for fluid resuscitation in ACUTE pancreatitis - a different entity from chronic pancreatitis. NEC risk: acute-pancreatitis guidance surfaces under chronic-pancreatitis queries. Dropped rather than risk misattribution.
